manuscript: Do deep time-series architectures beat naive baselines? A leakage-free out-of-sample benchmark on asset returns

environment.platform: AutoDL container image (dependencies as listed in requirements.txt)

baseline.forecast_origins_definition: sum of distinct asset-origin dates across the four assets; forecast rows are reported separately across five models

seed_replication.forecast_origins_definition: sum of distinct asset-origin dates across two additional seeds and four assets; forecast rows are reported separately across five models

budget_sensitivity.forecast_origins_definition: sum of distinct asset-origin dates across CSI300 and BTCUSD; forecast rows are reported separately across five models

how_the_numbers_were_produced: Tables 4–6 and 9–10 are regenerated from archived per-origin forecasts and analysis inputs; Table 8 is reconstructed from archived robustness summary files; Figures 1–6 use archived forecast aggregates and rolling-series files; Table 1 uses the four source-return CSVs included in data/ of the Zenodo archive; Table 7 is generated from the Table 6 bandwidth output.
raw_data: The four prepared source-data CSV files are included in data/ of the Zenodo code-data-replication archive. See data/README.md.
analysis_archive: The Zenodo collection contains the complete supplied forecasting code, third-party model implementations, analysis scripts, source data, and archived results corresponding to the manuscript.
trial_logs_existing_runs: not archived; selected hyperparameters, validation losses, selected epochs, seeds and trial budgets are retained per forecast origin. The runner writes trial-level Optuna CSV logs for future runs.
